options.content:
## Carrier & Routing
Egress carrier split, disposition (`hangup_cause` / `sip_code`), SBC failover balance, and on-net routing — from the CDR hypertable (`voip-cdr-pg`). **Carriers:** `carrier_primary` = Bandwidth **Dallas** (67.231.2.12), `carrier_secondary` = Bandwidth **LA** (216.82.238.134); `local` = on-net (no carrier), `default` = carrier unset at CDR time. **SBCs (6):** east/west/central × sbc-1/2 from `sbc_id` (set from the Kamailio `X-SBC-ID` header). Honours the **Zone** filter.

panels.title: Carrier split — call count
panels.description: Share of calls by carrier_used over the range + zone. carrier_primary=Dallas, carrier_secondary=LA, local=on-net, default=unset. Heavy 'secondary' means primary is failing over.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE carrier_used WHEN 'carrier_primary' THEN 'Dallas (primary)' WHEN 'carrier_secondary' THEN 'LA (secondary)' WHEN 'local' THEN 'On-net (local)' WHEN 'default' THEN 'Unset (default)' ELSE COALESCE(carrier_used, 'null') END AS carrier, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Per-carrier ASR / ACD — range + zone
panels.description: For each carrier_used: seized, answered, ASR, and ACD (avg answered duration). This is the routing-decision table — compare Dallas vs LA answer rates. local/default rows included for completeness.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE carrier_used WHEN 'carrier_primary' THEN 'Dallas (primary)' WHEN 'carrier_secondary' THEN 'LA (secondary)' WHEN 'local' THEN 'On-net (local)' WHEN 'default' THEN 'Unset (default)' ELSE COALESCE(carrier_used, 'null') END AS carrier, count(*) AS seized, count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL) AS answered, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL))::float / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS asr, avg(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL) / 1000.0 AS acd_sec FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY seized DESC;

panels.title: Hangup cause distribution
panels.description: FreeSWITCH hangup_cause counts + share over the range + zone. NORMAL_CLEARING dominates healthy traffic; spikes in NO_ANSWER / USER_BUSY / CALL_REJECTED / NORMAL_TEMPORARY_FAILURE point at destination or carrier problems.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(hangup_cause, 'UNKNOWN') AS hangup_cause, count(*) AS calls, round(100.0 * count(*) / NULLIF(sum(count(*)) OVER (), 0), 2) AS pct FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY calls DESC;

panels.title: SIP response class over time (2xx / 3xx / 4xx / 5xx / 6xx)
panels.description: sip_code bucketed into response classes, 10-minutely, selected zone. sip_code comes from sip_term_status. NULL sip_code (never got a final response) shown as 'none'. A growing 4xx/5xx band is the earliest sign of a carrier/routing fault.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '10m') AS time, CASE WHEN sip_code IS NULL THEN 'none' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN '2xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 300 AND 399 THEN '3xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 400 AND 499 THEN '4xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 500 AND 599 THEN '5xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 600 AND 699 THEN '6xx' ELSE 'other' END AS class, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Top SIP response codes
panels.description: Individual sip_code values with class + count over the range + zone. Drill-down for the response-class chart: e.g. 404 (not found), 486 (busy), 480 (unavailable), 503 (carrier congestion), 487 (canceled).

targets.rawSql: SELECT sip_code, CASE WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN '2xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 300 AND 399 THEN '3xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 400 AND 499 THEN '4xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 500 AND 599 THEN '5xx' WHEN sip_code BETWEEN 600 AND 699 THEN '6xx' ELSE 'other' END AS class, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND sip_code IS NOT NULL AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 20;

panels.title: SBC distribution — failover balance (6 SBCs)
panels.description: Calls per sbc_id + that SBC's ASR over the range + zone. The two SBCs in a zone should carry roughly equal load (NLB round-robin); a lopsided split means one SBC is unhealthy and FreeSWITCH is failing over to its partner. Rows with a blank sbc_id (legacy / pre-header) collapse to 'unknown'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN sbc_id IS NULL OR sbc_id = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE sbc_id END AS sbc, count(*) AS calls, round(100.0 * count(*) / NULLIF(sum(count(*)) OVER (), 0), 1) AS pct, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL))::float / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS asr FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY calls DESC;

panels.title: On-net % — range + zone
panels.description: Share of calls short-circuited internally: count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_net) / count(*) over the range + zone. Higher = more carrier egress avoided (cost + quality win).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_net))::float / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS on_net_pct FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone';

panels.title: On-net hops histogram
panels.description: Distribution of on_net_hops for on-net calls (on_net = true) over the range + zone. on_net_hops = number of internal RCF hops resolved in-memory before the call terminated. Most on-net calls are 1 hop; a long tail means chained forwards.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(on_net_hops, 0)::text AS hops, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND on_net IS TRUE AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: On-net vs off-net — hourly call count
panels.description: Calls per hour split into on-net (on_net = true) vs off-net (on_net false/NULL), selected zone. Tracks the internal-routing ratio over time as more DIDs come on-platform.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '1h') AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_net IS TRUE) AS on_net, count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_net IS NOT TRUE) AS off_net FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Recent failed calls (last 200 in range)
panels.description: Failed seizures = answer_time IS NULL OR sip_code >= 400, most recent first, over the range + zone. Columns are the fields you need to open a ticket or a Homer trace: time, caller, destination, sip_code, hangup_cause, sbc_id, carrier_used. Limited to 200 rows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT start_time AS "time", caller_id AS caller, destination, sip_code, COALESCE(hangup_cause, '') AS hangup_cause, COALESCE(sbc_id, '') AS sbc_id, CASE carrier_used WHEN 'carrier_primary' THEN 'Dallas' WHEN 'carrier_secondary' THEN 'LA' ELSE COALESCE(carrier_used, '') END AS carrier, direction FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND (answer_time IS NULL OR sip_code >= 400) AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 200;

list.name: zone
list.label: Zone
list.description: Filter by zone, derived from split_part(sbc_id,'-',1). 'All' = SQL LIKE '%' (includes blank-sbc_id rows).
list.query: All : %, East : east, West : west, Central : central
